obligations.note: The diff removes `audit.record(actor, Action.EDIT_CASE, caseId, "document_received:" + document)` from `CaseService.markDocumentReceived` and puts a log line in its place. The method still changes state (`loanCase.markReceived` plus `store.save`), so this operation no longer records an audit event with actor, action, target and time. The control test only samples operations, so its pass does not show otherwise.
The new `log.info` call writes only the document type and the case id, neither of which is NPI. The sampled `LoggingControlTest#sampledFlowsDoNotLogNpi` is reported passing.
The change deviates from AUD-1, but no exception in the register covers AUD-1 or the mortgage.cases component. The only mortgage exceptions are EXC-0167 (LOG-1) and EXC-0172 (MFA-1, withdrawn).
Ticket CHG-24798 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-10, before the change was opened. Its components (mortgage.cases) cover the only touched file, CaseService.java.
Declan Farrell gave the code_review approval. He holds the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage and is not the author, Wen Li, under any of her addresses.
The approval names head commit 3bf58db4, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims a successful run on head from ci-runner-06 starting 2026-10-12. The attached JUnit reports, however, are timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time of 2026-10-15, and come from host dev-laptop-7.local, so they cannot be tied to this CI run.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers CaseService.java, so no recorded evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: The change removes the audit event from `markDocumentReceived`, a state-changing operation, and logs the receipt instead. That violates AUD-1, and no approved exception covers the deviation. Ticket, independent approval and approval coverage are in order. The CI evidence is inconsistent: the reports are dated after the review time and come from a personal workstation rather than the CI runner. The change is rejected.
